prompts: Use case: background-extraction. Input image is the precise design reference. Extract/recreate ONLY the female futuristic companion character visible on the far RIGHT of this reference. Premium polished semi-realistic 3D illustration, same face/proportions/lighting/materials as reference, not flat vector or cartoon. Bust and extended hand, intact silhouette, no clipping at head/hair/hand. Transparent background with genuine alpha. Remove ALL text, holographic message panel, logos, phone, UI, flags, effects outside silhouette. Output portrait asset around 1024x1536. This is an image asset for an interactive app, not a mockup.

Preserve authentic rich sci-fi lighting and intricate ring details of reference, avoid simple vector look.

Very dark midnight navy starfield, subtle electric blue nebula glow, photographic Earth horizon curving up along BOTTOM EDGE ONLY occupying bottom 15% of frame, bright fine cyan atmosphere rim, visible night-side amber city lights and blue cloud textures. Upper 75% is quiet very dark navy for readable UI, sparse tiny stars. Match reference background and the Earth visible along the desktop lower edge and splash. No logo, no text, no panels, no buttons, no phone, no character, no bright central object. Premium cinematic digital render, not a diagram, no grid globe.

Use case: background-extraction. From reference extract/recreate the small luminous holographic blue human brain illustration in the bottom 'Cerveau IA' card. Isolated 3D brain, three quarter view, intricate electric cyan neural folds and pathways, softly glowing translucent blue hologram with thin orbital scientific rings and scattered particles, premium sci-fi render.
